## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `02ea176a18aabde68f10278d64c00ca851998ca1`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #20764 (body and all three comments: triage direction 5903760674, claim 5910003827, `os-dev-report` 5910417690); PR #20845 (body, file list, the net diff against `origin/main` at the head, its zero comments, its labels); the check-runs on the head; the timelines of #20695, #6732, #20420, #20442, #4745, #6727 and #6829, each read by this reviewer; `git log -p` on `platform-readings.md` for the reading's origin. Not fed: the dispatch order, the dispatching seat's conclusions.

**The diff.** One file, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, +3 / -3, lines 41-43 only; the PR's file list and `git diff origin/main...02ea176a` agree. One commit on the branch (merge-base `93e9e426`). File length 469 lines at the head and at `origin/main` (ratchet row `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md', 469]`, headroom 0). The three rewritten lines measure 120 / 118 / 120 bytes (`LC_ALL=C`), cap 120; no line in the file exceeds 120 bytes. The file contains no `#[0-9]{3,}` match.

**Check-runs on the head** (`filter=latest`, 30 runs): 18 `success`, 12 `skipped`, 0 `failure`, 0 `neutral`, 0 `cancelled`, 0 in progress. Every run not `success` / `skipped`: none. `Check Changeset` is `success` (11:44:17Z, after the `skip-changeset` label at 11:40:26Z); `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, all four `Type Check` lanes, `Check Documentation Links` and the three single-writer / claim guards are `success`. The skips are the path-filtered lanes (Build Core, Test Core shards, Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood, Build Docs, Packed-tarball) on a diff that touches no source. PR state: draft, `auto_merge` null, no queue event on its timeline, `mergeable_state: clean`.

### ① Derived judgments

The timelines, as this reviewer read them (`GET /issues/N/timeline`, all seven under the 100-event page; key events only):

- #6732: `auto_merge_enabled` 2026-08-08T13:47:43Z → `added_to_merge_queue` 14:01:50Z → `convert_to_draft` 14:04:32Z → `merged` 14:38:56Z + `removed_from_merge_queue` 14:38:56Z (`github-merge-queue[bot]`). Nothing between the add and the draft; no `removed_from_merge_queue` and no `auto_merge_disabled` between the draft and the merge. The merged PR still reads `draft: true`.
- #20695: `auto_merge_enabled` 2026-09-29T23:31:31Z → `added_to_merge_queue` 23:32:51Z → `convert_to_draft` 23:57:02Z → `merged` 2026-09-30T00:04:21Z + `removed_from_merge_queue` 00:04:21Z. Nothing between; merged PR reads `draft: true`. (Its earlier cycle the same day, unqueued: `auto_merge_disabled` 18:31:59Z three seconds before `convert_to_draft` 18:32:02Z, both by the seat.)
- #20420: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-09-28T13:43:01Z (no `auto_merge_enabled` event in that cycle) → `convert_to_draft` 14:02:28Z → seat comment 5871523278 at 14:04:07Z ("converted to draft and auto-merge disabled", describing group `pr-20420-3cf644938` as already failed on job 108955578884) → `removed_from_merge_queue` 14:11:24Z by `github-merge-queue[bot]`, unmerged → re-queued 16:02:24Z → merged 16:23:43Z. No `auto_merge_disabled` event anywhere in the cycle.
- #20442: `auto_merge_enabled` 13:44:00Z → `added_to_merge_queue` 13:45:42Z → `convert_to_draft` 14:02:50Z → seat comment 5871530372 at 14:04:29Z ("converted to draft and auto-merge disabled") → merge-queue-triage comments at 14:13:15Z (run 36431602315 red) and 14:30:41Z (run 36434107738 red, "本 PR 过去 24h 已在队列失败 1 次(不含本次)") → `removed_from_merge_queue` 14:35:44Z by `github-merge-queue[bot]`, unmerged → re-queued 16:43:21Z → merged 17:07:43Z. No `auto_merge_disabled` event. The second red run after the draft is a queue build of a PR the queue still held 28 minutes after its conversion.
- #4745: `auto_merge_enabled` 2026-08-03T01:28:46Z → `convert_to_draft` 01:29:30Z → `auto_merge_disabled` 01:29:30Z (same second) → ready 01:30:46Z, re-armed 01:30:52Z, queued 01:37:38Z, merged 01:49:07Z. Not queued at the draft.
- #6727: armed 2026-08-08T13:42:58Z → draft 13:44:36Z → disabled 13:44:36Z (same second) → ready 13:45:57Z, re-armed 13:46:02Z, queued 13:57:48Z, merged. Not queued at the draft.
- #6829: armed 2026-08-08T23:37:05Z → draft 23:40:25Z → disabled 23:40:26Z (one second) → ready 2026-08-09T05:48:17Z, queued 05:49:38Z, merged. Not queued at the draft.

Every row of the PR body's two tables matches what this reviewer read. In the four queued cases the draft conversion was followed by no removal event of its own; in the three unqueued cases the conversion was followed by `auto_merge_disabled` within one second, with the converter as actor.

**`:41`** 「转 draft 不是可靠的踢队手段:本仓与姊妹仓均见已入队转 draft 仍保位照合,处置按最坏走。」 — **right.** The "本仓" half is #6732 and #20695 above, both merged by the queue while in draft. The "姊妹仓" half is carried over from the file's own history (`2e9bca270`, 2026-08-27: 「objectui 2026-08-25 测得相反 —— 已入队 PR 转 draft 后条目保位、~40 分钟后队列照样合并」) — a pre-existing governed reading, not re-read by the dev and not re-readable from this repo; it is not a new claim. The dropped clause 「两向相反读数并存」 had, as its only "反" direction, the old "本仓" reading, which the next line falsifies; no opposite reading survives in any input. 「处置按最坏走」 is kept.

**`:42`** 「本仓转 draft 同秒掉 auto-merge 仅见于未入队时,转正后重挂;已入队者 2026-08-08、09-29 照合。」 — **right.** Dates verified: 2026-08-08 is #6732 (queued 14:01:50Z, draft 14:04:32Z, nothing between, merged 14:38:56Z); 2026-09-29 is #20695 (queued 23:32:51Z, draft 23:57:02Z, nothing between, merged 2026-09-30T00:04:21Z — the date pins the queue-and-draft day; the merge itself fell seven minutes past midnight UTC). "仅见于未入队时": in the four queued cycles no `auto_merge_disabled` followed the draft although auto-merge was armed in three of them (#6732, #20695, #20442); in the three unqueued cycles it always did. Precision note, not a defect: 「同秒」 is the observed value on #4745 and #6727; #6829 logs the drop one second later (23:40:25Z → 23:40:26Z), which the PR body reports as "(1 s)". The reading is of a platform-coupled drop, and the cap left no bytes for the caveat. The old "不自动恢复" survives as 「转正后重挂」, which #4745 and #6727 (re-armed only after `ready_for_review`) support.

**`:43`** 「补救:转 draft 与卸载 auto-merge 都做,本仓卸载单独不踢队;两手齐做亦未见踢队(08-08、09-28)。」 — **right, and it does not claim more than the evidence holds, on one condition it meets.** The remedy 「都做」 is the triage direction's, word for word in substance. 「本仓卸载单独不踢队」 is carried over (its source is PR #6799's text on #6732's reversal, `cd704cc4`). The new clause says 「未见」 — not seen — and that is the exact strength of the evidence: 08-08 is #6732 (both acts per #6799's text; the queue merged it 34 minutes later, in draft), 09-28 is #20420 and #20442 (both acts per seat comments 5871523278 and 5871530372; the queue held #20442 through a second build and ejected both only after red group builds, by `github-merge-queue[bot]`). What the line cannot say and does not say: that the disable was sent. On a queued PR the timelines carry no `auto_merge_disabled` event (verified on all four), so "both acts" rests on the seats' written claims and on #6799 — the PR body states that caveat in its own words, and that body is where the id-lint header places a reading's provenance. Had the line said 「两手齐做亦不踢队」 (does not dequeue) it would overclaim; 「未见踢队」 does not. The cause of #20420's removal (a red build at 14:01:49Z per the seat's comment, before the draft) is inferential in the sense that a timeline records no cause; the inference is well founded by the three sibling cases and the actor.

**The departure from the triage direction (`:42` "mixed" → "split by queue state").** Traced: the "drops queue membership" reading first appears in `db6581a5` (#4893, card #4892, committed 2026-08-03T13:59Z), in the SKILL.md note 「转 draft 会同时掉 auto-merge 与队列成员资格」, citing no PR. #4745, the same day at 01:29Z, logs the same-second auto-merge drop on a PR that was not queued — the queue-membership half had no instance then, and the trace finds none later: `ab19075e8` (08-12) restated it and `cd704cc4` / #6799 (08-09) cited #6732 for "only draft evicts", whose timeline shows the PR merged in draft 34 minutes after the conversion. No evidence for a draft dequeue exists in any input. A "mixed" line would therefore have asserted a direction with no instance behind it; the direction's assumption (the old half has its own measurement) was falsified by the measurement the direction asked for. "Split by queue state" is what the seven timelines support (unqueued: auto-merge drops; queued: the PR keeps its place), and it stays inside the direction's intent: a reading correction on a governed file, no new rule (the acts, the probe and 「处置按最坏走」 are unchanged), `:43`'s remedy kept. Accepted as flagged.

**Citations by date, not PR number.** Confirmed: `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` scans every `.md` under `SCAN_ROOT = '.claude/skills/pm-dispatch'` with `ID_PATTERN = /#[0-9]{3,}/g`, so `#6732` in this file reds the gate; the file cites zero PR numbers today and already pins readings by date (`:49` 2026-09-17, `:51` 2026-09-11, `:132`, `:193`, `:298`, `:305`). The gate's header states the rule: a reading's provenance lives in the PR that landed it. Dates suffice as a re-readable pin because the PR body carries the seven PR numbers with their events and the endpoint to re-read them, reachable from the line by `git blame` → commit → PR; 08-08 maps to #6732 and 09-28 to #20420 / #20442 without ambiguity in the scanned windows. Within the direction's intent (the pin is the timeline).

**Pins.** 469 / 469 lines hold (net 0); new lines 120 / 118 / 120 bytes, none over the 120-byte cap; table-row pin 0 unchanged (the file has no table). The dev's `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` claims are consistent with these measurements and with `Lint & Repo Gates` = `success` on the head.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right and is on the PR (label applied 11:40:26Z; `Check Changeset` = `success`). The diff touches `.claude/**` only, which no package's `files[]` ships, so nothing publishes from any released package (AGENTS.md §3, review-checklist.md 「本仓库走 `skip-changeset` 标签」). `Clause-②: no` is right and matches the claim (5910003827): no published schema, export or docs surface changes. Not a `Clause-②: yes` surface under contract-review.md's five faces except as governed rule text, which is why this record exists.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (5910417690), each answered:

1. `:42` "mixed" → "split by queue state": accepted on the evidence, see ①. Not a silent choice — flagged in the report and the PR body.
2. `:43` "not seen to dequeue" instead of "not measured": accepted, see ①; the disable half on a queued PR is attested by seat comments and #6799's text, never by a timeline event, and the PR body says so.
3. Dates instead of PR numbers: accepted, id-lint confirmed, see ①.
4. `:41` rewritten inside its line (86 → 120 bytes): within the cap, net 0 lines; the clause it drops had lost its only support.
5. `git fetch --deepen` on the shared clone: adds objects only, changes no tracked file; no action.
6. Commit trailers: the head carries `Claude-Session:` and the model-free `Co-authored-by: Claude` spelling; the card-trailer gate sits inside `Lint & Repo Gates` = `success`. No action.

`open_questions` (the eviction act, A vs B): escalated, not answered here. It is carried verbatim on #20847 ("Open question, for triage (it may need a maintainer)"), and PR #20854 implements option A in AGENTS.md (a queued governed pull-back goes to the maintainer for a manual removal). This PR adds no rule either way; its `:43` remains the status quo the question is asked about. The one manual removal the dev names, #20797 `removed_from_merge_queue` 2026-09-30T07:33:36Z by `os-zhuang` with no draft conversion, reads as stated.

Out-of-scope findings:

- AGENTS.md states the falsified reading as a premise in three places — verified at `origin/main`: `:285-:286` (Prime Directive 14, "draft is what removes queue membership, disabling alone drops only the arming"), `:428-:429` ("flipped back destroys auto-merge and queue membership at once"), `:532` ("flipping back to draft drops auto-merge and queue membership at once"). Filed as #20847 (`priority:p1`, `domain:skills`, `pm:dispatched`), with PR #20854 (draft, `AGENTS.md` +8/-7 and `SKILL.md:202` +1/-1) — Tier H, since one AGENTS.md path makes the whole PR Tier H. Escalated; outside this claim's file surface, correctly untouched here.
- The old reading originates in an unqueued case (#4745, same day as `db6581a5`): consistent with this reviewer's trace, recorded in the PR body, nothing to file.
- Seen in #6732's cross-references while reading its timeline and not judged here: #20855 (the queue guard's refusal text tells a seat to dequeue a governed PR), filed 2026-09-30T12:40Z — same family, for the seat's awareness.

**Landing order.** PR #20854's new Prime Directive 14 text cites this file's queue-membership section ("`platform-readings.md`, queue membership") for the reading it stops restating; this PR should land first so the cited section says what #20854 says it says. #20854 does not touch `platform-readings.md:41-:43`, so no conflict either way.

**Landing key.** The diff is Tier S (`.claude/**` only, one file), every check on the head is `success` or an expected `skipped`, and this record is a PASS on the current head at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` — under AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 and `landing-operations.md:59` that is the key: the owning seat may take the PR ready and through the queue. ⛔ Nothing here was posted, merged, queued, armed or re-run by the reviewer.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20764-draft-dequeue-reading`
Reviewed-by: `session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`

**VERDICT: PASS**
